rows.law: the mirror thesis: the overlay is the sovereignty
rows.claim: The fleet is structurally a DFHack: typed overlays over an engine nobody on the fleet wrote, and the overlay, not the engine, is the sovereign asset. The roblox mountain is the same move one layer out.
rows.quote: publish the tools. The overlay is the sovereignty. The engine was never ours;
rows.steal: File the missing DFHack mirror receipt in corpus/steal/ citing LINKS-345 (estate grep shows zero dfhack receipts there today); landing: corpus/steal/.
rows.falsifier: A mirror-table row with no real counterpart, or a fleet organ talking to the engine naked (raw provider calls outside chat_provider/probe_route) surviving ratchet review.

rows.law: disease as debt: escaped mutable state needs a named reconciler
rows.claim: DFHack's largest disease family is stuck-flags (8 of 47): state written but never reconciled, then trusted. The fleet's same disease is the swallowed exception and the stale cache; the cure is a named reconciler per escaped mutable state, exactly as fix/occupancy owns phantom occupancy.
rows.quote: mutable state that escapes a function boundary must have a named reconciler
rows.steal: Extend the violation ratchet so any new mutable state crossing a function boundary without a named reconciler registers as debt by name; landing: tools/violation_ratchet.py + configs/violation_baseline.json.
rows.falsifier: An except-pass or stale-cache site in mag/ that never drifts from ground truth across a full pytest run, showing the reconciler rule would be pure overhead; or a stuck-flags entry in dfhack_fixes.json whose family count does not reproduce (it does: 8).

rows.law: delete-when-X retirement receipts (fixes retire when upstream lands)
rows.claim: DFHack pruned 6 fixes (fix/diplomats, fix/build-location...) when upstream landed bugs 5991/3295/2606 and consolidated 3 occupancy fixes into one. Registered debt is not a museum: every baseline row needs an upstream condition so pruning is a ledger fact, and fix comments carry the bug number the way ours carry receipts.
rows.quote: Registered debt is not a museum: every baseline row needs an upstream condition ("delete when X") so pruning is a ledger fact.
rows.steal: Add a delete_when field to every row of configs/violation_baseline.json (upstream condition + date), so prune/baseline-update can retire debt as a ledger fact; landing: configs/violation_baseline.json.
rows.falsifier: A baseline row pruned whose upstream condition was never evaluated, or a row whose condition has long been satisfied yet still passes the ratchet (retirement is not actually a ledger fact).

rows.law: the enablement dial lives in the register itself
rows.claim: Each DFHack fix declares its safety mode in the register: always-on (quickfix), default-on periodic (dry-buckets), opt-in where auto-fix destroys wanted state (wildlife), manual-only documented dangerous under repeat (stuck-merchants). Automatic-vs-manual is a safety dial, not an afterthought.
rows.quote: every registered debt names whether a gate may auto-fix it or whether auto-fix destroys signal.
rows.steal: Add an auto_fix_safe dial column to violation_baseline rows so baseline-update records whether a gate may auto-fix; landing: configs/violation_baseline.json schema.
rows.falsifier: A registered debt where auto-fix behavior is decided ad hoc outside the register, or an auto-fix that destroyed signal on a row whose dial said safe.

rows.law: soul separate from body as data model
rows.claim: unit (living sim) and unit_soul (psyche: skills-with-rust, preferences, emotion ledger, needs, dreams) are separate records joined by a pointer, so the psyche is copyable whole into a DataStore. Emotions are timestamped rows naming their cause, not meters.
rows.quote: body and psyche as separate records, the psyche holding skills-with-rust, preferences, and the emotion/need/dream ledger
rows.steal: Keep Soul.luau mirroring unit_soul field-for-field (emotion ledger + DF cutoff ladder + needs pin already landed 2026-09-25 20:59) and wire HeadMuseum heads as thought-row ledgers, not editable mood scalars; landing: roblox/src/shared/Soul.luau.
rows.falsifier: A head/NPC whose mood cannot be represented as thought rows plus an aggregated scalar (state inseparable from the body record), or Soul.luau drifting from the unit_soul field list in dfhack_datamodel.json.
